title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theatre on 1972-08-24

ai_review.summary: Mono‑sounding recording with modest clarity captures a strong ’72 set highlighted by phenomenal Bird Songs and a thoughtful Dark Star>Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The tape sounds a bit dated – it comes across in mono and isn’t as crisp as other versions, which limits the listening experience. Musically, however, fans rave about the first‑set classics (Promised Land, Sugaree, MAMU, Bird Song) and especially the soaring Bird Songs of late ’72 plus an intriguingly crafted Dark Star>Dew pairing, making the show a solid addition to any Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives strong praise for song selection and performance (≈4.5/5) while recording quality is noted as mono and less crisp (≈2.5/5); weighted combination yields a ~3.9 overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono‑sounding mix, less crisp than other versions; no specific mention of audience or soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid with Promised Land, Sugaree, MAMU and Bird Song; second half builds on impressive Bird Songs of late ’72 and a thoughtful Dark Star>Dew transition, keeping the momentum high.
